name: StemNest Academy Team
bio: Our guides are written by the StemNest Academy tutors and curriculum team, who teach coding, game development, web development, data science and AI to children and teenagers in live online classes. Every tutorial is built from projects we teach and test in class.

name: Adorable Nwabugo
bio: Adorable is a StemNest Academy tutor with 7 years of teaching experience. Subjects taught include Scratch, Code.org, Web development, MIT App Inventor, Thunkable, Machine Learning for Kids, PictoBlox and Python.

name: Mannasseh Jackson
bio: Mannasseh is a StemNest Academy tutor with 8 years of teaching experience. Subjects taught include Scratch, Code.org, Web development, MIT App Inventor, Thunkable, Machine Learning for Kids and Data science and analytics.

bio: Patricia is a StemNest Academy tutor with 6 years of teaching experience. Subjects taught include Scratch, Code.org, Web development, MIT App Inventor, Thunkable, Machine Learning for Kids, PictoBlox and UI/UX design.
